> Find the concepts a set of SDRF documents wrote inconsistently, one row per finding and spelling.

Wire verb `sdrf lint` · Python `pymzlib.sdrf.lint` (not yet shipped)

### Wraps

- [`SdrfDriftLint.Analyze`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDriftLint.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfDriftLint.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfCollection`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCollection.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCollection.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stdin` | `string[]` | required | — | `>= 1 line` | Exactly as sdrf pool: one document per line, path then optionally a TAB and a label; label all or none. Labels are how the documents column names each file. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_count` | `int` | documents | never | Documents linted. |
| `paths` | `string[]` | — | never | The paths in stdin order. |
| `labels` | `string[]` | — | never | Each document's label: supplied, or mzLib's containing-folder/file-stem default. |
| `finding_count` | `int` | findings | never | Distinct findings (not rows). |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | One row per finding x variant, findings in mzLib's impact order, variants majority first. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Five static caveats, plus one when no labels were supplied. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `finding_index` | `int` | — | never | 0-based finding; rows of one finding share it. |
| `kind` | `string` | — | never | AccessionNameConflict \| NameAccessionConflict \| MixedTermAndFreeText \| ColumnNameVariant \| ValueCaseVariant (SdrfDriftKind member names). |
| `concept` | `string` | — | never | What was written inconsistently: an accession, a term name, a normalised free-text value, or a normalised column name (lower-cased, whitespace runs collapsed), by kind. |
| `column_name` | `string` | — | yes: a ColumnNameVariant finding, which is about a column's NAME rather than its values | The column whose values drift. |
| `variant_rank` | `int` | — | never | 0 = the majority spelling, then by frequency. Descriptive, not advice. |
| `value` | `string` | — | never | This spelling as written; for MixedTermAndFreeText, "controlled vocabulary term" or "free text". |
| `occurrences` | `int` | documents | never | How widely this spelling was used. At 23c2490e every kind counts documents. |
| `documents` | `string[]` | — | never | Labels of the documents that used this spelling, a list cell (labels are caller text, so no delimiter could be undone). |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | stdin empty; a blank path; a file not found; some lines labelled and some not |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | mzLib cannot read one of the documents |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- The majority spelling describes what the documents do; it is not advice (organism is free text in 963 curated documents and a CV term in 275).
- Never compared, being unique per row by construction: source name, assay name, comment[data file], comment[searched data file] (mzLib 1.0.592, #1335), comment[file uri], comment[source document].
- Reserved words and empty cells are skipped, so documents that say nothing lint clean; see sdrf assess.
- No --threads: SdrfDriftLint.Analyze is one call over the whole collection and does not parallelise.

### Example

```python
drift = pymzlib.sdrf.lint({'sdrf_cohort.sdrf.tsv': 'cohort', 'sdrf_cohort_partner.sdrf.tsv': 'partner'})
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`sdrf_lint_cohort.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/sdrf_lint_cohort.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.
